reply_b: We open in a medium so the flashback arrives quietly, as a private moment, not a big reveal. The story beat here is about two men and a closed box—tension in the space between them—so we hold back on scale until the lid opens and the argument starts; that’s our first escalation. On craft: the eye‑level handheld MS keeps both faces and the box readable, leaves clean negative space for the “Six hours earlier” cue, and anchors the axis for all the tighter singles and inserts that follow. The 35mm/f4 gives just enough environment—rain, that green bulb, the sodium rim—without turning it into an establishing shot, so we can push in later when it matters.
